sphere_commentary.overview: Across all series, outcome scores cluster around 6.95 with tight variance, indicating consistent therapeutic signal despite population diversity. HEALING shows highest listener consistency and crisis-appropriate low scores, THRIVING shows peak efficacy in focus and creative flow zones, while TRANSFORMING exhibits the most spread as expected for low-affect work. Most protocols operate within the 0–10 scale interpretation window, with no protocol showing systematic floor effects beyond crisis DESCENT arcs. YouTube reach data remains structurally incomplete due to NULL retention fields, limiting reach/retention pattern analysis.
sphere_commentary.cross_series: The three series differentiate themselves along design intent rather than mean outcome. HEALING demonstrates highest stability and crisis-tolerant scoring structure. THRIVING reaches the highest efficacy peaks in CREATIVE FLOW and FOCUS & CLARITY, with HOLD protocols showing mixed engagement. TRANSFORMING protocols display the widest variance and最 sensitive dependence on entrainment dynamics, with several protocols showing bimodal qualitative responses. Bimodal distributions in X-MC-L3 and X-ME-L3 flag potential population mismatch and are the strongest cross-series flag.
sphere_commentary.anomalies: Several protocols show divergent signal from peer clusters, especially those with high cross-run drift. X-MD-L3 (7.15, n=13) exhibits extreme drift and bimodal change ratings, signaling analytical instability. H-SL-L1 (7.19, n=54) shows high drift despite large n, suggesting possible volume or groove drift in current volume. T-FC-L3 (7.63, n=35) produces high drift and semantic isolation from its series cluster, raising fragility risk. AutoGluon cross-zone routing flags suggest TRANSFORMING protocols are over-represented in crisis and sleep zones, indicating structural signal misalignment between series labeling and predicted utility.
sphere_commentary.development_signals: Strong convergence on several development leads. [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] Test L2 variant for H-OS-L1 since n=95, mean=7.15 shows high consistency with L2 (n=51, mean=6.92). [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] Extend hold phase for T-MB-L3 (n=14, mean=6.93) given AutoGluon predicts 7.693 for maintenance zone and semantic isolation suggests under-engagement. [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] Deploy X-ME-L1 (n=39, mean=6.74) to crisis and sleep buckets since AutoGluon routes it as top-tier across multiple zones despite modest mean score. [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] Validate X-MD-L2 (n=14, mean=6.21) for population split due to high variance and low settle-time correlation. [SINGLE SOURCE — hedge] Reroute H-CR-L3 to crisis-adjacent bucket given AutoGluon predicted crisis leader of 7.955 versus observed 6.52.
sphere_commentary.embedding_analysis: Cross-run drift shows notable instability across 18+ protocols, most severely in TRANSFORMING and Maintenance protocols. CROSS-RUN DRIFT: 14 protocols exhibit sim < 0.700, signaling evolving data patterns or analytical fragility. CROSS-PROTOCOL SEMANTIC CLUSTERS reveal that protocols cluster by rhythm pattern not series, with H-SL-L1/H-SL-L2 showing highest coherence (sim=0.869), while H-OS-L3 and T-FC-L3 remain analytically isolated. Embedding data quantity is sufficient to identify drift but insufficient to confirm cluster robustness — confidence in embeddings is moderate with high uncertainty on isolated nodes.
